'''Velumia''' was the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] [[Velus]], the [[Velus system]]'s [[Star/Legends|sun]].<ref name="Core" /> The planet, like the rest of its [[Star system/Legends|system]], was located in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="AtlasCorr" /> Velumia was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] with seven [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="Core" /> The planet, along with the rest of its system, was located along the [[Shawken Spur]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], connecting it to the [[Shawken system/Legends|Shawken]] and [[Thokos system/Legends|Thokos systems]]. The Velusia system, and therefore Velumia itself, was additionally connected by another hyperlane to the [[Scipio system/Legends|Scipio system]].<ref name="Routes" />

==Behind the scenes==
Velumia was mentioned in ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', a [[2003]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Core" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Velus [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Velumia, in grid square L-9.<ref name="AtlasCorr" />
